description: This MATLAB script estimates Open Circuit Voltage (OCV) parameters by loading data, defining residual functions, and performing optimization routines such as fmincon and particleswarm to fit model parameters.

methods.name: residualFun
methods.description: Calculates residuals between measured and modeled OCV based on parameters, used for optimization.

methods.name: residualFun2
methods.description: Calculates residuals with a different approach, used for optimization.
